 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Portland Trail Blazers are on the road Saturday afternoon as they travel to take on the Utah Jazz in a Western Conference matchup.
 Portland enters Saturday's game with a 3-1 record after losing at home to the Memphis Grizzlies Thursday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Portland Trail Blazers forward Deni Avdija (8)© Troy Wayrynen-Imagn Images
 In Thursday's loss, Deni Avdija led the way for the Trail Blazers as he recorded 24 points, nine rebounds and seven assists while Donovan Clingan added 11 points, eight rebounds and five blocks of his own.
 The Trail Blazers will try to bounce back Saturday as they face off against a struggling Jazz team on the road.
 Utah enters Saturday's contest with a 1-4 record after losing at home in overtime to the San Antonio Spurs Wednesday night.
 Utah Jazz guard Keyonte George (3)Rob Gray-Imagn Images
 Keyonte George led the way for the Jazz in Wednesday's loss as he ended the game with 31 points, four rebounds and three assists while Darryn Peterson recorded 18 points, five rebounds and three assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Saturday afternoon's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Trail Blazers Injury Report: Will Ja Morant, Robert Williams III Play?
 Portland Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant (1)Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 The Trail Blazers have four players listed on their injury report, including Ja Morant and Robert Williams III.
 Portland has ruled out Morant due to a left hamstring strain that he suffered in Thursday's loss and he is expected to miss at least four weeks with the injury.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With Morant sidelined, Scoot Henderson and Jrue Holiday could both be in line for increased roles.
 The Trail Blazers have listed Williams III as questionable due to left knee injury management and he is in danger of missing his second straight game.
 Portland Trail Blazers center Robert Williams III (35)Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images
 Chris Youngblood has also been listed as questionable due to left ankle soreness while Shaedon Sharpe has been ruled out as he continues to recover from right meniscus surgery.
 Jazz Injury Report: Will Lauri Markkanen Play?
 Utah Jazz forward/center Lauri Markkanen (23)Trevor Ruszkowski-Imagn Images
 Utah has listed Lauri Markkanen as available to play following a 1-game absence due to a right wrist sprain.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Jazz have ruled out Jaren Jackson due to a right MCL tear while Jusuf Nurkic remains sidelined while recovering from a right foot injury.
 Fans can catch Saturday afternoon's matchup between the Trail Blazers and Jazz from the Delta Center at 1 p.m. ET.
